colorSpace.label: Color Space
colorSpace.description: Defines how CorridorKey interprets the input footage before inference. If the input looks wrong here, all inference outputs will be based on that incorrect interpretation. Changing this after inference does not rewrite existing output files.

despillStrength.label: Despill Strength
despillStrength.description: Controls the intensity of green spill removal on the foreground. Higher values remove more spill but may affect fine edge detail.

despeckle.label: Despeckle
despeckle.description: Removes small isolated artifacts from the matte. Any disconnected regions smaller than the threshold (in pixels) will be removed.

refinerScale.label: Refiner Scale
refinerScale.description: Controls edge refinement quality. Higher values improve edge detail at the cost of processing time. A value of 0 disables refinement entirely.

livePreview.label: Live Preview
livePreview.description: When enabled, the current frame is reprocessed automatically whenever parameters change. The first adjustment after launch may briefly pause while the inference engine loads.

fg.label: FG Output
fg.description: Exports the isolated foreground with green spill removed. Can be written as EXR or PNG.

matte.label: Matte Output
matte.description: Exports a single-channel alpha matte where white represents foreground and black represents transparency.

comp.label: Comp Output
comp.description: Exports a visual composite of the key over a checkerboard background. Intended for review, not compositing.

processed.label: Processed Output
processed.description: Exports full RGBA straight-alpha output in linear color space. Intended for compositing and color pipelines such as DaVinci Resolve or Nuke.

birefnet.label: BiRefNet
birefnet.description: Fast, high-quality one-click alpha generator suitable for a wide range of footage. Recommended default option.

gvmAuto.label: GVM Auto
gvmAuto.description: Automatic green-screen matting optimized for people. Works best on traditional green screen footage.

trackMask.label: Track Mask
trackMask.description: Uses painted foreground and background strokes as prompts to generate a dense tracked mask using SAM2.

matanyone2.label: MatAnyone2
matanyone2.description: Advanced matting model that refines masks generated from tracked prompts. Useful for complex edges and motion.

videomama.label: VideoMaMa
videomama.description: High-quality temporal matting model that produces smooth, stable alpha mattes over time.

importAlpha.label: Import Alpha
importAlpha.description: Allows importing external alpha mattes from other tools. Supported formats include image sequences and standard video files. Imported alphas replace existing hints if confirmed.

input.label: Input
input.description: Shows the original unprocessed footage as interpreted by CorridorKey.

mask.label: Mask
mask.description: Displays painted foreground and background strokes used to guide mask tracking and matting.

alpha.label: Alpha
alpha.description: Shows the alpha hint currently used as input for inference.

fg.label: Foreground
fg.description: Displays the extracted foreground with green spill removed.

matte.label: Matte
matte.description: Displays the inferred alpha matte (white = opaque, black = transparent).

comp.label: Composite
comp.description: Shows the final composite over a checkerboard background.

processed.label: Processed
processed.description: Shows the final straight-alpha RGBA output intended for production use.

showTooltips.label: Show Tooltips
showTooltips.description: Enables helpful explanations on all interactive UI controls.

uiSounds.label: UI Sounds
uiSounds.description: Plays sound effects for actions such as starting jobs or completing inference.

copySourceVideos.label: Copy Source Videos
copySourceVideos.description: Copies imported videos into the project folder. When disabled, source files are referenced in place.

loopPlayback.label: Loop Playback
loopPlayback.description: Loops playback within the defined in/out range while scrubbing or playing the timeline.

defaultOutputDirectory.label: Default Output Directory
defaultOutputDirectory.description: Sets a global output location for inference results. Outputs are organized by project and clip name to prevent collisions.

extracting.label: Extracting
extracting.description: The video is currently being extracted into an image sequence.

raw.label: Raw
raw.description: Frames are loaded but no alpha hint has been generated yet.

masked.label: Masked
masked.description: Paint strokes exist and the clip is ready for mask tracking or matting.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: An alpha hint is available and the clip is ready to run inference.

complete.label: Complete
complete.description: Inference has finished and output files have been written.

error.label: Error
error.description: Processing failed. The operation can be retried.
